summary: Fix executor.py indentation bug causing failed observations to be dropped, and add a control_flow edit to inject a generic failure heuristic.

edits.hypothesis: Injecting a generic instruction into the message history upon tool failure prevents the agent from uncritically accepting negative consensus from fallback models, addressing the 'uncritical_acceptance_of_contradictory_vqa_output' mode without leaking specific tool names.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: A prompt-only edit in the system message is always active and may dilute focus; this control-flow injection activates only when evidence is compromised by tool failure, providing targeted correction.
edits.trigger_condition: When tool_failure_reason(obs) returns a non-None value in the executor loop.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000001, q000004, q000005, and q000008, the roi_crop tool failed with a KeyError. The injected message would have explicitly warned the agent not to treat subsequent negative VQA outputs as definitive, prompting re-examination of original pixels which likely contains the subtle positive finding. (preservative) On successful tasks like q000003 or q000007 where no tools fail, this mechanism does not activate, preserving the direct visual reasoning habit. (transfer) Generalizes to any domain where primary inspection tools fail and fallback models are prone to false negatives.
edits.regression_risk: Minimal; the message is only injected on failure and reinforces existing system prompt instructions without contradicting them. It adds one message to the context window only in failure cases.
edits.mechanism: Injecting a generic instruction into the message history upon tool failure prevents the agent from uncritically accepting negative consensus from fallback models, addressing the 'uncritical_acceptance_of_contradictory_vqa_output' mode without leaking specific tool names.
